entries.7a49aa0b8a273997: Under its philosophy, 'The Human Based Company　We aim to be a company that grows and continues with people,' the company advocates a 'digital native company' and states that it aims for sustained growth by building a growth engine centered on LaKeel DX and a stock-type revenue model. As its 'LaKeel Strategy (LaKeelify or die),' it states that it will broadly establish LaKeel DX as a digital business platform for various companies and expand its ecosystem through a mechanism that allows customers to sell applications and services developed on LaKeel DX to external parties. Issues to be addressed include securing and developing human resources, developing new services and strengthening technological capabilities.
